description: Source code implementing IPC (Inter-Process Communication) for fsmonitor, including support checks, query and command sending, and daemon spawning.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if fsmonitor IPC is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Returns the IPC socket path for the given repository.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current IPC active state.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Sends a query to the fsmonitor daemon, optionally spawning it if not running.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the fsmonitor daemon.
